title: The gates' news boards: res/field/gate_boards/gates.json or news.json
description: One of the two archives of the gate gimmick's news boards (field_gimmick_gate.c), as a list of its members in order: gates.json, ARCID_FIELD_GIMMICK_GATE_ZONE_DATA (a/1/7/2), or news.json, ARCID_FIELD_GIMMICK_GATE_BOARD_ENTRIES (a/1/6/4). tools/data/gate_board_data.py packs them.

gates.description: The gates' boards, a GimmickGateZoneData each. GimmickGate_LoadZoneData takes the first whose zone is the player's and whose version is the game's or null; in zones 0x177 and 0x17b it takes the next one instead when the player's city (GameData_GetMyCity) is 1

position.description: Where the board stands, in whole units (GimmickGate_PlaceBoard shifts them into fx32)

direction.description: The DIR_* the board faces: DIR_DOWN turns it 0 degrees, DIR_RIGHT 90, DIR_UP 180 and DIR_LEFT 270 (GimmickGate_PlaceBoard); it also sets the camera of the board's event (gimmick_obj_elboard.c)

animation.description: The board model's animation, an index of sBoardAnimations (GimmickGate_StartBoardAnimation)

enabled.description: Whether the board shows its messages at all

messages.description: The board's messages (messageIds), numbers of the system text bank 0x2b

message1.description: messageIds[1], which the code never reads

rotation.description: messageIds[3] to [11], which GimmickGate_AddWeekdayMessage3 to 5 pick three of by the day of the week, a day apart

weekdays.description: messageIds[12] to [18], the message of each day from Monday to Sunday (GimmickGate_AddWeekdayMessage6)

weather_zones.description: The zones whose weather the board reports when no roamer or reported weather gives one (fallbackZones, GimmickGate_GetWeatherZones)

news.description: The news, a GimmickGateBoardEntry each, all loaded by GimmickGate_LoadBoardEntries; a board shows the news whose flag is set and whose zones have its own

flag.description: The event flag that turns the news on, a constant of generated/flags.txt (flagId)

clear_flag.description: Whether showing the news clears its flag (unk08, GimmickGate_AddBoardMessage)

message.description: The news' message, a number of the system text bank 0x2b (unk0c, GimmickGate_AddEntryMessage)

type.description: 0 for news shown alone, by GimmickGate_FindBoardEntry, or 2 for news listed with the others of type 2, up to three (GimmickGate_FindListEntry)

zones.description: The gates whose boards show the news; none for every board
Up to four zones; the rest of the four are ZONE_MAX, none

version.description: The VERSION_* this applies in, or null for both
